note:
The control this study never ran. Every collapse arm changed TWO things at once: KV dtype
(bf16 -> fp8_e5m2) AND learning rate (1e-6 -> 1e-5). Every bf16 run is at 1e-6. So the claim
'fp8-amplified mismatch drives the collapse' has no bf16-at-1e-5 arm to rule out 'LR 1e-5 alone
collapses this setup'. This cell runs exactly that: bf16 KV, LR 1e-5, no TIS, 30 steps, seed 1234
-- identical to the collapse arm except the KV dtype. If it stays stable, the fp8 attribution
holds. If it also collapses, the headline causal claim needs rewriting.
